metadata.case_name: PANG PING SUM v. ENPACK (HONG KONG) LTD AND OTHERS

source: CT scan showed a skull base fracture being a stable and non-displaced fracture of right lamina of the cervical 7th vertebra.

injuries.description: Fracture of right ulnar styloid (right wrist)
source: X-ray showed fracture of right ulnar styloid.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: Stable and non-displaced fracture of right lamina of the cervical 7th vertebra (C7)
source: CT scan showed a skull base fracture being a stable and non-displaced fracture of right lamina of the cervical 7th vertebra.
Dr Chans report dated 1 September 2003 states that the plaintiff has persistent neck pain radiating to the right scapula... The neck pain is a consequence of the C7 lamina fracture which has healed.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other specified cervical vertebra

injuries.description: 4-cm laceration wound over the left occiput (scalp laceration)
source: He was found to have a 4-cm laceration wound over the left occiput and tenderness over the right wrist, right lower chest wall and lower part of neck.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Post-concussional syndrome (residual headache and impaired memory)
source: In April 2002 the plaintiff returned to the A and E Dept of UCH complaining of headache and was diagnosed to be suffering from post-concussional headache.

Dr Pangs report dated 6 February 2004 states that the plaintiff still suffers headache due to post concussional syndrome, neck pain and right wrist pain as well as right frozen shoulder (likely due to immobilization of the right arm from the plaster cast).

Dr Edmund Woos report dated 24 September 2003 states that in the mental state examination conducted, the plaintiff demonstrated a mild impairment in tests of orientation and memory. He also has residual headache and impaired memory consistent with mild post-concussional syndrome.

injuries.description: Right frozen shoulder (likely due to immobilisation from arm cast)
source: Dr Chans report dated 1 September 2003 states that the plaintiff has persistent neck pain radiating to the right scapula, right frozen shoulder (due to the arm cast resulting from the injury) and deformed/painful right wrist.

Dr Pangs report dated 6 February 2004 states that the plaintiff still suffers headache due to post concussional syndrome, neck pain and right wrist pain as well as right frozen shoulder (likely due to immobilization of the right arm from the plaster cast).
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

source: During 21 to 23 July 2002, he was admitted to the Medical Department of UCH upon further complaints of headache. On this occasion the diagnosis was compatible to adjustment disorder.
In August 2002 the plaintiff was referred to the East Kowloon Psychiatric Centre where he was diagnosed to be suffering from depression.

manifestations.description: Lost consciousness for a short period of some minutes
4-cm laceration wound over the left occiput
Mild impairment in orientation and memory; impaired memory
Persistent neck pain radiating to the right scapula
Deformed/painful right wrist resulting in a weaker right hand grip

treatments_received: Taken by ambulance to the A and E Department of United Christian Hospital
Transferred to the Neurosurgical Unit as well as the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of UCH for further management
Long arm plaster applied for the fracture to the ulna
Neck collar applied for the cervical spine fracture
Follow-up at the Orthopaedics Department until June 2002
Admission to Medical Department of UCH from 21 to 23 July 2002
Referral to East Kowloon Psychiatric Centre (diagnosed with depression)
Multiple attendances at A and E Dept of UCH for headaches and shoulder pain (various dates)

losses.description: Pain suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA awarded by the court)
